newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere shares indicated sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere shares indicated sharply up.

text.p: Shares in Lagardere Groupe were indicated to open sharply higher after the company was made the preferred candidate by the government to acquire Thomson SA for a symbolic franc.
Trading in Lagardere will start at 0800 GMT after suspension on Wednesday. Lagardere was bid/ask at 140 francs at 0700 GMT, against a Tuesday close of 133.10 francs.
The upper limit for Lagardere on Thursday is 146.40 francs and the lower limit is at 119.80. If the share breaks any of these two limits, it will be temporarily suspended.
